def para(text="", bold=False, italic=False, size=None, align=None, style=None, color=None, after=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style) if style else doc.add_paragraph()

    if align: p.alignment = align

    return p

def add_runs(p, text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None, color=None):
    # supports **bold** segments
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, seg in enumerate(parts):
        if not seg: continue
        r = p.add_run(seg)
        r.bold = bold or (i % 2 == 1)
        r.italic = italic
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if color: r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
    return p

def bullet(text, level=0):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    add_runs(p, text); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def numbered(text):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Number"); add_runs(p, text); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def table(headers, rows, widths=None, header_fill="1F3A5F", size=9, sevcol=None):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
    t.style = "Table Grid"; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text = ""
        r = c.paragraphs[0].add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(size); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
        shade(c, header_fill)
    # repeat header row
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr(); th = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader"); th.set(qn("w:val"), "true"); trPr.append(th)
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""
            lines = str(val).split("\n")
            for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
                p = cells[i].paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else cells[i].add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
                add_runs(p, ln, size=size)
            if sevcol is not None and i == sevcol and val in SEVCOL:
                shade(cells[i], SEVCOL[val])
                for p in cells[i].paragraphs:
                    for r in p.runs: r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF); r.bold = True
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i, w in enumerate(widths):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)

def kv_table(pairs, widths=(1.6, 4.9), size=9.5, fill="DCE6F1"):
